fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.description: Alibaba Cloud RAM AccessKey ID used to call ACK. Create or manage AccessKey pairs here: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ram/user-guide/create-an-accesskey-pair

fields.label: Access Key Secret
fields.description: Alibaba Cloud RAM AccessKey secret from the same pair. Alibaba Cloud shows it only when the key pair is created: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ram/user-guide/create-an-accesskey-pair

actions.name: get_temporary_kubeconfig
actions.description: Generate a short-lived kubeconfig for an Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster.

regionId.description: The Alibaba Cloud region ID that contains the cluster, for example cn-hangzhou.

temporaryDurationMinutes.description: The temporary kubeconfig validity period in minutes, from 15 minutes to 3 days.

privateIpAddress.description: Whether the kubeconfig should use the cluster's internal API server endpoint. Defaults to false for the public endpoint.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for generating a temporary ACK cluster kubeconfig.

config.description: The kubeconfig YAML containing credentials for the connected Alibaba Cloud identity.

expiration.description: The RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the kubeconfig expires.

outputSchema.description: The generated temporary ACK kubeconfig and its expiration time.
